expectations.text: Cuts the 11 planned channels down to a small opening surface
expectations.evidence: Under Critical: "**11 channels is taxonomy sprawl.** ... Cut to ~4–5 for launch: general, help, announcements (staff-posted), showcase. Fold random/off-topic/jobs/contributors into general for now. Only split out kubernetes/python/go if you can already name a specific person who reliably answers each one — otherwise they're three more empty rooms." It names the target count, lists the exact opening channels, specifies what to fold in, and gates the remaining topic channels on a named answerer — a fully explicit cut to a small opening surface.
